notes.title: Update v1.2.6
notes.content:
After a user brought it to our attention, we revamped the 'background moaning' in H-Scenes to loop throughout the scene, muting itself when a voice line is playing. These moans can be muted in the Options menu under the [i]Sexy[/i] Voice Volume setting.

Also fixed an issue in Chinese where some lines were out of sync.
